Here we recall that for a complex number z = α + jβ, e−zt = e−(α+jβ)t = e−αt e−jβt Now |e−jβt | = 1 regardless of the value of βt. Therefore, as t → ∞, e−zt → 0 only if α > 0, and e−zt → ∞ if α < 0.
